llm.summary: This skill is a coherent Wyze robot vacuum controller that clearly discloses its credential use, token reuse, and start/pause/dock capabilities.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is checking and controlling a Wyze robot vacuum, and the script implements only status, start, pause, and dock commands for matching Wyze vacuum devices.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are explicit, command-driven, and include safety guidance to start cleaning only on a clear user request and to act on the named vacuum.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Setup requires Node and installing the external wyze-node dependency under the skill scripts directory; this is disclosed and proportionate, though it carries normal third-party dependency risk.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill reads Wyze API credentials from a configured env file and contacts Wyze through an unofficial client, which is expected for the integration and disclosed in the documentation.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: It creates or uses a Wyze token directory and reuses cached login tokens shared with the Wyze skill; this persistence is disclosed and scoped to Wyze authentication.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install this only if you are comfortable giving the skill access to your Wyze API credentials and cached Wyze session. Because it uses an unofficial Wyze client, API behavior may break or change, and start commands should be used deliberately because they move a physical device in your home.
